d:
Who were the Thugs of India, and how did they become one of the most feared criminal networks in colonial history?
This episode of Alif Laila explores the chilling story of Amir Ali, the infamous thug whose life was immortalised in Philip Meadows Taylor’s 1839 novel Confessions of a Thug. Discover how these gangs allegedly befriended travellers before murdering them, the secret language and rituals described in historical accounts, and how British officer William Henry Sleeman led the campaign against Thuggee.
